svg.title: Reuse completed work while keeping the evaluation order
svg.desc: First verify the input files and run identity, then resolve each locked outer fold. A valid completed-fold cache reuses its saved predictions and stage selection. Otherwise, reuse valid stage checkpoints and training and validation embeddings, or calculate missing work, and fit training-only probes. Select the training stage using validation data before evaluating held-out test clips and fitting the baselines. Raw per-clip features can be reused, while classifiers and scalers are fitted within the fold. Save the completed fold. After all folds finish, require exactly one correctly attributed test prediction per clip before writing the report.
svg.text: Reuse work without changing the experiment
Check the run once, resolve each fold, and combine results only after all folds finish.
1. Verify the inputs and run identity
Check actual input bytes, split registry, configuration, update budgets, code, and environment.
A stored manifest must match this run; its saved artifacts must pass their checksum checks.
COMPLETE-FOLD HIT
Reuse this fold's results
Keep its saved stage selection
and held-out predictions.
No retraining or baseline fitting
is needed for this complete fold.
No valid complete fold? Calculate what remains.
2. Reuse or calculate both training stages
Reuse or compute checkpoints and train / validation vectors.
Fit training-only probes; unfinished training stages restart.
3. Choose the stage using validation scores
The test clips have no role in this choice.
4. Evaluate the fixed choice on the test clips
Reuse or compute per-clip features for the baselines.
Fit baseline scalers and classifiers on this fold's training data.
5. Save the completed fold
Save predictions and selection; commit the manifest last.
Atomic writes keep incomplete files from looking complete.
The reused result has already
passed the same validation
selection and test-evaluation
steps for this run identity.
6. Check all out-of-fold predictions, then write the report
Require exactly one test prediction per clip, with the correct source, label, and locked fold.
Both paths produce a self-contained evaluation folder. Cache reuse does not change the split rules.
